areas.spec_summary: GEOMETRY TOKENS (app-mockup.html:8, tokens.css): --ab:44px (icon rail) · --lp:238px (left panel; surfaces draw .sp-left 240px, sim .lphost 230px) · --rp:300px (right panel) · --titleh:40px · --gtabh:38px (global tab row) · --ctabh:36px (per-pane content tabs, editor area) · --viewh:46px (surface view header). Four data-theme token sets (mockup:10-17): brand-light (chrome #E7E4EF, accent #6F5BE6, yellow/AI #F6A823, font "Hanken Grotesk"), brand-dark (chrome #0E0A14, accent #8B7BF0), night (Segoe UI, accent #6F5BE6), google (Google Sans, #1A73E8). TITLE ROW (40px, mockup:133-142): [.menu] File · Edit · View · Go (12.5px spans, hover pill — maps to native menu bar on macOS; sim HTML:137-148 gives minimum menu contents: File→New note, Daily note; View→Home, Mission Control ⇧Tab, Inbox, Search, ✦ Take the tour; Go inert/undefined) → centered [.omni] search pill (flex:1, max-width 520, h28, pill radius, surface bg+border, magnifier icon, label "Search or ask your vault…", trailing keycap "Ctrl K", click opens the combined Search-or-Ask palette; mockup script 5457 binds Ctrl/Cmd+K, sim:709 binds Ctrl+K AND Ctrl+O) → [.tourpill] "✦ take the tour" (h22, dashed border, hover accent; opens onboarding overlay; contract copy at mockup:5360 "replay: the ✦ pill in the title bar") → window buttons – ▢ ✕ (32×26; ✕ hover red — native traffic lights on macOS). GLOBAL TAB ROW (38px .gbar, mockup:143-176): [.hub] workspace button (h28, surface bg, border, radius 8: house icon + hubName "Home" + chevron; dblclick→switch to Home workspace, mockup:5449) with #wspop popover (top:36/left:8, min-w 230): cap "Workspaces", rows = colored dot + name + aft "4 tabs"/"5 tabs", ＋ New workspace, foot "each workspace keeps its own tabs · double-click the pill → Home". Sim's richer popover (app-sim.js:586-605,633-645, w290): Scope chip section (workspace · area · project · pin), "Favorites" group with ★ toggle per row, nested child workspaces indented, tab-count aft per row, ＋ New workspace / Rename current / Archive current, foot "Home is protected · archive is soft — restore in Settings"; on ambient tools the cap reads "Vault-wide tool — open a workspace:" and hub label shows "Liv". [#gtabs] global tabs: h32 pills, padding 0 15, radius 9 9 0 0, 12.5px, active = canvas bg + font 600 + 3px canvas strip fusing tab to canvas; seed Home=[Overview, Thesis(🔒), Tournament]; lock = 14px padlock chip, tooltip "category-locked global tab — only Thesis content opens here" (mockup:5377,5386). Sim tab model (behavior truth, app-sim.js:404-475,607-620): tabs are per-workspace TYPED department containers {name, dept, sub?, entity?} — depts: Editor(note/canvas/table/kanban), Files(view/folder/list), Quick Capture, Dashboard, AI Chat, Tasks, Library, Comms, Import — drawn as icon + name + 6-char dept tag + ×; tab.select/tab.close (closing the last mints a blank); [＋ gbtn] "New tab — a blank landing, never instantly a note" and a ⌄ dept picker ("New tab — departments only (object kinds live inside)"; Ask never mints a tab: "The answerer is stateless — no tab needed"; Import routes into Library); blank-landing card: "Create new note Ctrl N / Go to file Ctrl O / Choose tab type — all departments" + "a blank tab becomes an Editor once content materialises". [.gfav] favorites/slot pills right-aligned behind a border-left: 22px ◦-pills "◦ climbing", "◦ SSK invoices", ghost "＋ pin"; sim slots bar (js:629-635, own 30px row): "◦ Today" (red, opens the daily note), "◦ Important" (pinned filter tier:1 → opens the palette pre-filled), "◦ Liv" (workspace switch), ghost "＋ Add a slot" ("a workspace, a bookmark, or a label+URL"), caption "slots — links, workspaces, today, pinned filters"; hidden on ambient tools. [.gact] Layers gbtn (title "Layers — saved tab setups") with #laypop (top:36/right:8): cap "Layers", mi "Save current tabs as a Layer…", sep, cap "Restore", rows "Thesis sprint · 4 tabs"/"Invoice day · 2 tabs", foot "a Layer lists pointers — restore reopens tabs, never rewrites content"; sim restore MERGES non-duplicate tabs into the current workspace, toast "Layer "X" restored — N tabs merged into this workspace · a Layer lists pointers, nothing was written" (js:471-476); sim also puts an ↶ Undo (Ctrl+Z) gbtn here · gsep · ← → back/forward gbtns — history = ring of (surface·workspace·tab) places, cap 40, "Back (Alt+←)"/"Forward (Alt+→)", dimmed at ends (js:298-311,563-564). ICON RAIL (44px .act, mockup:178-194): 36×36 buttons (radius 9, hover, active = accent-soft bg + accent + 3px left bar at -7px), 13 items in order with contractual tooltips: 1 Notes "Notes — the daily note is today" · 2 Capture "Capture — the doorway that asks nothing (Ctrl+Alt+Space)" · 3 Inbox "Inbox — Route and Tidy" wearing TWO badges (grey "3" top-right = Route/scrap count, amber "2" bottom-right = pending assist suggestions; .bdg 15px min, 9px/700; amber uses --yellow/--on-yellow; sim badges() zeroes amber when the automation switch is off) · 4 Tasks · 5 Library "Library — files, links, lists, views" · 6 Contacts · 7 Calendar · 8 Comms "Comms — read-only messages, resolved to people" · 9 Dashboard-grid "Mission Control (Shift+Tab)" · [20×1 separator] · 10 Ask "Ask — cited answers from your own notes" (opens overlay, not a surface) · 11 Vault-graph "Vault graph" (overlay) · [spacer] · 12 Theme (cycles brand-light→brand-dark→night→google, toast "Theme: X", mockup:5466-5468, sim theme.cycle) · 13 Settings. Sim ambient-mode chrome: rail nav to a vault-wide tool keeps the tab row but swaps #gtabs for "vault-wide tool — the workspace lens does not apply here". Keyboard (sim:705-716): Esc closes overlays/popovers innermost-first; Ctrl+K/Ctrl+O palette; Ctrl+Z undo; Shift+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+M toggle Mission Control. Workspace switch behavior (sim ws.switch): always lands on the desk, restores that workspace's tabs (mints a blank if none), toast "Workspace: X — its own tabs restored, landed on the desk · scope …". LEFT-PANEL FOOTER (mockup:397): .nt-lfoot bordered 30px button — folder icon + "Vault: Viktor" + chevron (the vault indicator/switcher; no popover specified anywhere). Boot: Home workspace, notes surface (mockup:5469-5470).

The as-built band-embedded TabStrip (Window.swift:1379-1387) moves down into this row; the 40px title band above keeps only omni pill + tour pill (+ whatever survives of the toggles/timer — see open questions).

deltas.title: Favorites/slots pill row in the chrome

deltas.title: Back/forward chevrons move from rail-top to the tab row; add ⌥←/⌥→

Amber bottom-right must count pending assist suggestions and read 0/hidden while automation is off (sim badges(): amber = S.automation ? pending : 0). deltas.title: Theme button at rail bottom cycling four named skins

deltas.title: Shift+Tab toggles Mission Control

Per the feature-complete-space-conservative rule these features must keep a home (⌘⇧`/⌘⇧' chords survive regardless; + moves into the tab row): flag placement to the owner rather than silently dropping — the timer chip especially has no slot anywhere in the new chrome.

open_questions: Where do the two panel-collapse toggles and the running-timer band chip live in the new chrome? The mockup's title row shows only menu · omni · tour pill · window buttons — no toggles, no timer (as-built Window.swift:1363-1407).

Go menu contents are undefined in both mockup and sim (the span is inert). Populate with the sim's nav verbs (Home/Inbox/Back/Forward/Daily note)? Owner call.
Ctrl+K on macOS: assumed ⌘K. Do ⌘F (canonical per P13 ruling) and ⌘O stay as aliases of the same palette, or does ⌘K become canonical?

Hub double-click: mockup switches to the Home WORKSPACE (script 5449); as-built opens the Home hub surface (.lotusGoHome). Assumed the mockup wins — confirm, since the old bp4 ⑥ ruling said hub-surface.
Rail Capture item: front the existing ⌃⌥Space capture panel, or does a Capture SURFACE exist for the rail to navigate to (the sim has a capture dept surface)?
Layer restore: does the pane-geometry blob (as-built app.layer.geo.<id>) survive, given the new contract says a Layer lists tab pointers only and restore merges rather than replaces?
History cap: sim 40 vs as-built 200 entries — assumed keep 200 (behavior-invisible).
Does the lists surface (Surface.lists, folded into Library on the rail) disappear from Surface entirely, or stay reachable elsewhere?

areas.spec_summary: THE TOKEN SYSTEM (app-mockup.tokens.css; same block at app-mockup.html:9-17): four complete themes selected by a root data-theme attribute — "google", "brand-light", "brand-dark", "night" — each a full token swap, never layout ("skin, not behavior — one token swap, applied instantly, app-wide"). Per-theme tokens (exact values): SURFACES --chrome (window frame/titlebar/rail: google #E9EBEF, brand-light #E7E4EF, brand-dark #0E0A14, night #0A0B16), --canvas (content background behind cards, also the fill of the ACTIVE global tab so it merges into the page: #F1F3F4 / #F0EEF6 / #17121F / #0F1122), --surface (cards, popovers, toasts, kanban tiles, key fields: #FFFFFF / #FFFFFF / #201A2B / #171A2E), --panel (left panel, footbars, dropdown lists, log wells: #F6F8FA / #F3F1F8 / #171220 / #12142A), --panel2 (chips, toggle tracks, meta tags, small fills: #F1F3F4 / #EEEBF5 / #1C1628 / #171A30). TEXT TIERS --text/--text2/--text3/--muted (google #202124/#444746/#5F6368/#80868B; brand-light #1B1623/#4a4553/#6B6675/#9A93A6; brand-dark #ECEAF2/#C3BDD0/#A79FB5/#6E6780; night #C9CCE0/#A9AEC8/#8B8FA8/#5F6488). BORDERS --border/--border2 (google solid #DADCE0/#C9CDD2; brand-light rgba(27,22,35,.1)/.16; brand-dark rgba(255,255,255,.09)/.15; night .08/.14). --hover is ACCENT-TINTED in brand themes, not gray (brand-light rgba(111,91,230,.06), brand-dark rgba(139,123,240,.1), night rgba(111,91,230,.1); google #F1F3F4). areas.as_built: The as-built shell derives everything from macOS system appearance (NSAppearance aqua/darkAqua), in lake green. (1) Theme enum: shell/macos/Sources/Window.swift:13-18 — exactly three static colors: accent = lake green #2f7d6b (rgb 47,125,107), accentDeep #276456, accentTint = accent@12%; interface.md:72-74 and :305 codify lake green as the one accent. (2) Token table: shell/macos/Sources/Tokens.swift:13-36 — dyn(light,dark) NSColor pairs keyed off system appearance: background #ffffff/#1f1f1f, foreground #202124/#e8eaed, surface1 #ffffff/#2d2e30, surface2 #f1f3f4/#1b1b1b, popover #ffffff/#292a2d, panel #f1f3f4/#1b1b1b, secondary #e6e8ea/#42474c, mutedFg #4d5155/#b1b7bd, border #c2c6cc/#51565c, destructive #d93025/#f28b82, warning (amber AI) #e37400/#fdd663. Two text tiers (foreground/mutedFg), one border, no hover token, no accent-soft (accentTint serves), no per-theme semantic green/red/yellow/purple set. Radii are constants Tokens.swift:40-43 (4/6/8/12); motion Tokens.swift:48-51 is a 0.32,0.72,0,1 spring (not the mockup ease .16,1,.3,1); geometry Tokens.swift:55-59 (rail 44, headerBand 40). Fonts: 100% system SF via .system(size:) everywhere; Editor.swift:208-328 uses NSFont.preferredFont/monospacedSystemFont; no bundled fonts, no Fraunces, no Hanken Grotesk. (3) Appearance switching: Chrome.swift:532-542 — a sun/moon headerButton "Toggle appearance" flips NSApp.appearance between aqua/darkAqua and persists "app.appearance"; Settings.swift:515-543 AppearancePanel — segmented Light/Dark/System driving NSApp.appearance, a LockedRow "Accent — Lake green means selection and today; amber means AI. The palette is the product.", and a footnote deferring Reading mode and glyph strength; the settings search index entry Settings.swift:48-49 is "appearance.theme" keywords "light dark system theme". No theme list, no theme cards, no shape flavor, no UI-font, no glyph-strength control, no "What it looks like" General row. (4) VALUE_HEX law: Hues.swift:1-116 — P11.5b ruling R3, FROZEN: FNV-1a-64 hash of the display string → 9 seed hues (#f43f5e/#f59e0b/#0ea5e9/#8b5cf6/#f97316/#06b6d4/#3b82f6/#84cc16/#ec4899), frozen test vectors in the header; chip mixes keyed off NSAppearance (bg 12%/16%, border 32%, ink 62%/55% blends, Hues.swift:70-87); Hues.degrees() renders a status option's per-option `hue` cell in DEGREES at fixed sat/brightness (Hues.swift:92-105); optionColor ladder Hues.swift:111-116 (hue cell wins → VALUE_HEX → caller renders dates/recurrence/tier neutral). Consumed in 10 files (RowKit.swift x8, Window.swift x3, InspectorEditors.swift x2, VaultGraph.swift x2, Dashboard/Graph/Inspector/Settings/Tabs x1). Chips are colorful always-on by law ("no toggle"). (5) Amber AI: Halo.swift:12-40 — halo() modifier, 1px Theme.warning edge + 3px @14% wash, one-shot pulse; WarningBadge Tokens.swift:92-103 (amber@14% capsule); Theme.warning used in Chrome/Import/RowKit/Settings/Window (14 sites). (6) Selection: Theme.accentTint row fill + 2.5px accent left bar (RowKit.swift:269-271), accent rail icon + accent@12% fill (Chrome.swift:381-394).

deltas.title: Four named themes replace system light/dark — a full token system
deltas.detail: Replace the dyn(light,dark)-off-NSAppearance scheme (Tokens.swift:13-36) and the 3-color Theme enum (Window.swift:13-18) with an app-selected theme carrying the complete token set of app-mockup.tokens.css for google / brand-light / brand-dark / night: chrome, canvas, surface, panel, panel2; text, text2, text3, muted; border, border2; hover (accent-tinted in brand themes: rgba(111,91,230,.06) light, rgba(139,123,240,.1) brand-dark, rgba(111,91,230,.1) night); accent, accent-soft, on-accent; green, red, yellow, purple; radius (8/10/10/8), pill; font stack; shadow (per theme), tabshadow (google only 0 -1px 2px); plus root constants on-yellow #3a2a00, mono, popshadow 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35), ease cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), brandfont Fraunces. Exact hex values in the tokens block (app-mockup.html:9-17) — copy verbatim, no re-derivation. Theme selection becomes shell state (app-scope, this machine, e.g. AppStorage), decoupled from NSApp.appearance; 'darkness' (brand-dark, night) comes from the selected theme, so every isDark(NSAppearance) branch (Tokens.swift:15, Hues.swift:66-68) must key off the theme instead. Surface remap while porting: background→canvas, surface1→surface, surface2/panel→panel, secondary→panel2, popover→surface+popshadow, foreground→text, mutedFg→text3/muted (split into the 4 tiers), border→border/border2 (split), destructive→red, warning→yellow. Touches every file (200+ Theme.* references across 14 Swift files).

deltas.title: Retire VALUE_HEX hashed per-value hues — neutral chips + semantic-token dots
deltas.detail: The mockup/sim keep NO per-value hue anywhere: .chip is neutral (panel2 bg, text2 ink, border 1px, pill, 11px/600); the only value color is a 6px-class dot from the theme's semantic set. Delete/bypass Hues.valueHex + the 9-seed table + the FNV hash (Hues.swift:28-60) and the chip mixes at its 10 consumer files (RowKit x8, Window x3, InspectorEditors x2, VaultGraph x2, Dashboard, Graph, Inspector, Settings, Tabs). Replacements per the sim: status dots via word map STATUS_HUE (app-sim.js:342): todo→muted, active→accent, draft→yellow, done→green, paid→green, sent→yellow, else muted; space/area dots fixed semantic tokens (sim:11-14); subject dots from the same set (html:554); file-format colors pdf→red, xlsx→green, pptx→purple, link→yellow (sim:1767); overdue chips restyle text+border to --red (sim:372); graph nodes theme-neutral — 'node color is parsed but never rendered' (sim:2855-2864). Because hues are tokens, they re-map per theme (night mutes green to slate #5E86B0 etc.) — colors must be token lookups, never cached NSColors. This overrides P11.5b ruling R3 (the FROZEN header of Hues.swift) and the 'chips are colorful always-on' law. Core option `hue` cells stay in the data (schema-on-read) but stop rendering unless the open question below resolves otherwise.

deltas.title: Bundle and apply the brand fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Fraunces (brand serif)
deltas.detail: As-built uses SF system fonts exclusively. New spec: --font is a theme token (google → Google Sans stack, brand themes → 'Hanken Grotesk', night → 'Segoe UI Variable') plus an app-scope UI-font setting (Google Sans / Hanken Grotesk / System) that the Appearance pane exposes; Fraunces serves as --brandfont, used for the onboarding brand mark (.ob-mark html:4997: 28px rounded square, accent-soft bg, accent ink, 15px/700 Fraunces) and implied for Reading mode's 'serif body'. open_questions: Default theme: the mockup badges 'Google Workspace' as default on the theme card and 'Google Sans' as default UI font, yet the html root and the sim both boot brand-light ('Liv · Light') and the General row shows 'Liv · Light'. Which is the true first-run default for the shipped app — Liv · Light (pitch-consistent) or Google Workspace (as badged)?

Theme picker behavior: the mockup HTML renders four selectable theme cards (direct select, .on state), but the sim's behavior truth makes every Appearance row click CYCLE the theme (title 'click cycles the theme'). Should the native pane direct-select per card with the rail button as the only cycler, or reproduce cycle-on-any-click?

Shape flavor shows 'Soft · 12px' selected while the active brand-light theme's --radius token is 10px — is Shape flavor an app-scope override of the theme's radius token (and does 'Soft' mean 12 replacing 10), or is the mockup's selection state decorative?

UI font is labeled 'app-scope, independent of theme' yet --font is a per-theme token (brand themes ship Hanken Grotesk, google ships Google Sans, night ships Segoe UI Variable). Presumed resolution: the theme supplies the default and the setting overrides it — confirm, since the sim never implements the font setting.

Status dot colors: the sim hardcodes a word→token map (todo/active/draft/done/paid/sent), but the as-built law (Hues.swift:92-116) renders each status option's per-option `hue` cell in degrees — and user vocab words are arbitrary. Does the option hue cell survive as an override quantized to the semantic tokens, or does the fixed word map (unknown→muted) fully replace it?

Font shipping on macOS: 'Google Sans' is not redistributable and 'Segoe UI Variable' does not exist on macOS — should the google and night themes fall through to the system font (SF) as their CSS stacks would, and should the 'Google Sans' font card then read/behave as system?

VALUE_HEX retirement scope: Hues.swift declares the seed table FROZEN by ruling R3 ('changing any of these is a spec break'). The mockup unambiguously drops hashed hues, but confirm with the owner that R3 is formally superseded before deleting, since the ruling text forbids exactly this edit.

areas.spec_summary:
NEW spec (app-mockup.html §s-tasks, ".tk-" block, header comment "BP-6 ported to the shared shell, 2026-07-14 rulings applied"; behavior in app-sim.js registerSurface('tasks') lines 1477-1695). THREE-PANE surface: [left Tasks nav | center pool+4 lenses | right [Selection|View] rail].

LEFT NAV (sp-left card): header "TASKS" (11px caps) + "＋ view" button (title "new saved view"). Section FOCUS: rows Today(sun icon)·2, Upcoming(calendar)·6, Untriaged(dashed circle)·2 [tooltip: "no plan date, no deadline, no project — waiting for a decision"], All tasks(checked square)·11; active row = accent-soft bg. Sim count semantics (fits(), sim:1497-1503): today = !done && (plan≤T || deadline≤T); upcoming = deadline>T; untriaged = no deadline && no project; Focus counts respect the active project filter (sim:1590), project counts = non-done tasks per project (sim:1597). Section PROJECTS: rows with 7px colored dot (workspace hue, else muted) + name + count: thesis·2, Liv·2, mockup·1 (indented, class tk-sub, tooltip "sub-projects show leaf-only names"), SSK·3, personal·2; click filters the pool, click again clears (sim action 'tasks.proj', sim:1692). Section SAVED VIEWS: star rows Money owed / Tournament prep / This week.

TOOLBAR: h2 = pool/view title "All tasks — by status" + count "11 tasks"; project-filter chip "title ✕" when filtered (sim:1611); right-aligned seg [List|Board|Sched(label "Schedule")|Cards] with tooltip "four lenses on the same pool — switching never touches filters"; amber pill button "✦ 3 of these I could do" (sim variant: "✦ N waiting in Tidy", rendered only when amber badge>0 and automation on), data-nav=inbox, tooltip "3 suggestions wait in Inbox › Tidy — nothing runs before you approve"; style: 28px pill, 1px --yellow border, 10% yellow bg.

LIST LENS (one card): section headers = 8px status RING dot (option hue: Open=green, Discuss=accent, Follow up=yellow, Back burner=muted) + "Open · 3" caps label. deltas.title: Left Tasks nav panel (FOCUS section)

open_questions: OQ-A (bp9 31): Google sync conflict UX is unspecced — proposal is a per-event card in the Inbox Tidy queue (keep mine / take Google's / open both); needs an owner ruling before the sync work package.

OQ-B (bp9 32): recurrence exceptions (skip/move ONE occurrence) — override-on-parent recommended but unruled; affects Google exception mapping. As-built recurrence (services/src/recurrence.rs) has no exception support.

Chip hue source: bp9 e5 says chip hue = the calendar property's hue; the sim colors by area→workspace hue (no calendar property in its seed). Which wins when both exist — and should a default 'calendar' property be seeded in services (core-zone change, owner call) or created lazily by the shell on first 'New calendar…'?

Ctrl+D vs ⌘⌥D for the daily note on macOS — keymap area decision; calendar copy must follow the final map.
Default selection = 'next upcoming event in scope' keeps the rail on [Selection] — confirm Esc-on-grid returns to [View] even when that default selection exists (sim implies yes: Esc returns here).

No `message` kind exists: the starter library seeds exactly note/task/event/person/project (services/src/lib.rs:954-960) and lotus_set_type_at refuses unknown type names (services/src/content.rs:1552-1557 via ffi/src/lib.rs:1731); no FFI verb creates a new kind (verb inventory ffi/src/lib.rs — 50 lotus_* fns, none is create-kind). What DOES exist and is reusable: external-id is a bootstrap property (core/src/entity.rs:78 props::EXTERNAL_ID=12; named "external-id" services/src/lib.rs:864); the import service dedupes links/notes by external-id both in-batch and against the store — but skip-only, it never updates an existing entity (services/src/import.rs:79-117), and its ImportItem enum is Link/File/Note/Scrap with no Message variant (import.rs:24-38); the Note variant hardcodes type=note and maps frontmatter keys→cells, creating properties as needed (import.rs:170-198); FFI lotus_import_batch_at takes the items JSON (ffi/src/lib.rs:2099-2140); the shell has an Import flow (shell/macos/Sources/Import.swift). The search DSL supports key:value equals on any named property plus has:/no:/is: (services/src/search.rs:93-127), so type:message / source:Slack / has:from / unread:true style view queries work once the properties exist. The snapshot's EntityRow carries kinds:[String] + generic cells:[CellRow] (Window.swift:75-94), so message fields need no new wire shape. There is no fetch/connector infrastructure anywhere — core/services/ffi Cargo.tomls have zero network deps — and no ICS-style merge policy exists yet in services (grep for feed-owned/ics is empty). The right rail today is single-pane with lenses Metadata/Assist/Outline/History/Graph (Chrome.swift:62-80) — no [Selection|View] seg, no Copilot naming. deltas.title: Real refresh semantics: feed-owned upsert by external-id (the ICS merge policy)
deltas.detail: What a real fetch needs beyond file-drop import: an UPSERT path — match by external-id; when the entity exists, update ONLY feed-owned cells (from/sent/body) and only when changed; never touch user cells (subjects/related/status/anything user-added); when absent, create. Today's import is skip-only (no update on dedupe hit, import.rs:79-117) and no ICS-style merge policy exists anywhere in services — this is new services logic + likely one additive FFI verb. The feedback doc mandates "the ICS merge policy verbatim"; unread should be set only at first creation (a re-fetched read message must not re-flag). Live connectors (Slack/Mail APIs) are explicitly a fence-opening, sequenced behind MCP connectors (AI catalog A7) — NOT part of this port; nothing runs on a timer regardless.

All prose is preview-only; all values pool-validated; every write is a card. This is a program, not a slice — sequence per owner priority; every row needs its accept seam mapped to an existing lotus verb (or flagged additive FFI).

deltas.title: Dedupe survivor rule conflict — as-built keeps the OLDER, mockup keeps the NEWEST
deltas.detail: The mockup's duplicate card: 'Exact duplicate — keep the newest, append the older body into it? − the 6d copy (duplicate) + body appended into the 5d copy · history kept'. As-built propose_dedupe makes the OLDER id the survivor (clerk.rs:544 area; p16-ai.md:158 'survivor = older id (deterministic)'), and catalog O2 also says 'keep the OLDEST'. The mockup adds body-append-into-survivor, which no current command expresses. Core behavior is settled/read-only — this needs an owner ruling before anything changes.
deltas.anchor: mockup Tidy duplicates card (txt :517-528) vs clerk.rs dedupe + catalog O2

deltas.title: Onboarding + tour touchpoints for the new AI grammar
deltas.detail: The tour's automation card copy becomes 'on — assist may point (quiet ✦ marks) and propose. It writes only when you accept, and every suggestion waits in one queue: Inbox › Tidy. Off = fully manual, nothing suggests.' — and the tour should now also name Ask/Copilot as things the switch kills. As-built assist step exists (Onboarding.swift:109,258-272) and needs only copy + coverage updates. (Coordinate with the onboarding area mapper.)

open_questions: Search→Ask handoff mechanics: the mockup sells ONE Ctrl+K 'Search or ask' doorway, but neither artifact shows the transition — the sim binds Ctrl+K to search and opens Ask only from the rail button/dept redirect; the search overlay has no ask affordance, and the only hint is the facet-rail line '0 results never dead-ends: ⏎ hands the query to the palette'. Is Ask entered by ⏎ on a question-shaped/zero-result query, a mode toggle in the palette, or only via the rail button?

Undo law conflict: the Ask card promises 'on accept: by:assist provenance + 30 s undo' (and catalog O8/A7 repeat '30 s undo'), but lotus law is one never-expiring ⌘⌥Z step (Window.swift:3354 'Accept is one undo — ⌘⌥Z never expires'). Keep the stronger lotus law and treat '30 s' as a floor, or is a toast-with-countdown affordance itself required?

Dedupe survivor: mockup 'keep the newest, append the older body into it · history kept' vs core 'survivor = older id' + catalog O2 'keep the OLDEST' — three-way conflict touching read-only core; owner ruling needed.

Catalog status column ('built' = old Liv src/lib code) — is it also the build-priority ordering for lotus (built rows first), and are 'planned' rows (O8/O9/T11/B3/B4/A4-A7/I3) explicitly out of scope for this reconciliation?

Suggestion aggressiveness 'Eager — also on save when core fields sit empty' and catalog O6 suggestion toasts (5-min poll) both collide with lotus's no-timer/no-uninvited-chrome law (P16 refused toasts outright). Does the aggressiveness dial legitimize proactive surfacing outside Tidy, or do Standard/Eager only govern in-queue emission?

Plan section: the mockup's 'Liv subscription — server-side proxy, 62% of cap' vs the sim's BYOK-only 'no middle server' copy — which ships in the desktop app, and is the usage meter real telemetry or a mockup affordance?

Ask/assist id grammar: cards display ids like assist/iou/steven-owes-me-300#type+people+amount and ask/chase-invoice-114#due+people; as-built identity is a u64 fingerprint + decline_key triple. Is exposing a human-readable id string (additive FFI) sufficient, or must the dismiss store actually re-key on the slug grammar?

Per-row severability inside one card ('✕ drops a row; accept applies what remains'): implement as accept-subset-of-commands (new services/FFI seam) or by splitting proposers into per-fact proposals that group visually? The latter changes dedupe/decline semantics.

Sim labels the Ask action card 'PROPOSAL' and stages-only ('routed to the one queue — nothing written here'); the mockup labels it 'REVIEW' with Accept writing directly (plus 'also queued in Inbox › Tidy'). Which is the accept semantic: write-on-accept-in-overlay, or stage-then-commit-in-Tidy?

areas.spec_summary: SETTINGS = a FULL SURFACE, not an overlay (mockup `section#s-settings data-surface="settings"`, comment "BP-13 ported to a normal surface"; sim navigates via the ambient-bar gear act('nav','settings')). Layout `.st-wrap` = sp-left rail card + sp-mid panes (pane max-width 880, centered) + a foot bar. LEFT RAIL: (1) "search settings…" pill (magnifier icon); (2) hint: "entries carry group · scope · kind — the same grammar as vault search. 0 results never dead-ends: ⏎ hands the query to the palette."; (3) caption "OPTIONS"; (4) six nav items with icons + right-aligned aft tags, exact order: General [3 settings], Appearance [app], Properties [vault], Vocabulary [vault], Shortcuts [app], AI [app]. Every pane header carries the page title + an accent scope tag (app/vault). GENERAL ("the honest page. Liv keeps very few real settings — the rest of this surface tunes display, density and vocabulary."): accent-left-border note "exactly three user settings: where the store lives · what it looks like · whether the assist layer runs. everything else in here is vocabulary and display — a setting never forks behavior."; Row "Store location [1 of 3]" — "one plain folder of markdown and files — that folder IS the database. a cloud-synced local folder (Google Drive, iCloud) works too. moving the store moves your files; nothing else changes." + mono path (sample "G:/Min enhet/Liv/") + "Move…" button; link-row "What it looks like [2 of 3]" — "theme, shape, type — a token swap, never a layout or behavior change" → Appearance, value "Liv · Light ›"; link-row "Whether the assist layer runs [3 of 3]" — "the automation switch — the consent boundary. it lives on the AI page, next to who pays for the model." → AI, value amber chip "✦ on ›"; scopenote "scope tags on every row: vault rows write to .liv/settings and travel with the store · app rows stay on this machine." APPEARANCE (app; "skin, shape, type and reading comfort. everything here is a token swap — no layout, no behavior changes with the theme."): Theme section ("applies instantly, app-wide — one token swap") = 4 preview cards: Google Workspace [default], Liv · Light (on), Liv · Dark, Night; swatches verbatim from theme tokens (google #E9EBEF/#FFFFFF/#1A73E8, light #E7E4EF/#FFFFFF/#6F5BE6, dark #0E0A14/#201A2B/#8B7BF0, night #0A0B16/#171A2E/#6F5BE6); "Shape flavor" seg [Google · 8px + pill | Soft · 12px (on) | Square · 4px] "a radius-token swap only — pills stay pills"; "UI font" cards (app-scope, independent of theme): Google Sans [default], Hanken Grotesk [brand] (on), System — sample line "Agenda — SSK finals, 14 aug"; "Reading mode" toggle "notes opened read-only render with a serif body and a narrower measure. display-only — the file never changes."; "Inline glyph strength" seg [Normal (on) | Minimal | Off] "off keeps navigation icons, dimmed — the app stays usable." PROPERTIES (vault; "every property, everywhere it shows — one screen, no surprises. core always renders (empty = a dashed promise), more renders only when it holds a value, hidden never renders. this table and the inspector edit one schema; there is no settings-version of a property."): section "Properties · 15" + "+ Add property"; legend (core/more/hidden cell styles + "n note · t task · c contact · e event · f file · v view"); matrix columns Property (with hint sublabel: form "structure of the note", type "what it is", project "leaf shown", tier "1–3 · AI never writes it", date "role-typed: occurred · due · valid-until", status "per-kind vocabulary", active "hide when empty ✓", sources "where it came from", customs "custom · on N (…)") / Type chip (select/list/number/date/text/checkbox, clickable) / Key (kbd digit 1–0 or dashed "·") / Shows-on = six per-kind cells each in state core (accent), more (outline), hidden (dashed, faded) / hover "⋯" row menu; footnote "click a cell to cycle core → more → hidden for that kind · spine properties hide, never delete · customs delete safely — frontmatter values stay in your files (schema-on-read) · row ⋯: rename · change type · change icon · hide when empty · keys are edited in [Shortcuts — one map]" (ghost link to Shortcuts pane). VOCABULARY (vault; "your words, layered the way every picker sees them: ① this vault → ② Liv's seeded set → ③ create. the AI suggests from these shelves only — it never coins a value."): pill tabs subjects | type | form | status | area; shelf "In your vault · 7" (chips: hue dot + word + count); shelf "Liv's seeded starter set · 6" + action "Hide all seeded", dashed chips with hover ✕ "Hide from pickers" (a seed is renameable — träning "renamed from workout"); shelf "Hidden · 3" (struck-through chips with + "Restore"); section "Status vocabularies · per kind — one status property — your words, not ours": rows note (to-summarize, summarized, + add), task (waiting, nagged, paid, dropped, + add), event (registered, attended, cancelled, + add) with kind icons; footnote "click a chip to rename or recolor — vault-wide, count-confirmed above 20 objects · the task board re-keys its columns instantly · a seed that gets used migrates up to the vault shelf with count 1 · hiding is reversible forever." SHORTCUTS (app; "one table owns every binding. a key means the same thing in the inspector, the search palette and on suggestion cards — rebind it here and all three re-key together."): "Property digits" ("jump-and-edit in the inspector · toggle the facet in search · pick the field on a card") 2-col grid: 1 form · 2 type · 3 subjects · 4 project · 5 area · 6 people · 7 tier · 8 date · 9 status · 0 description; "Commands" ("same table, same grammar") rows w/ scope: Ctrl+K search or ask the vault (everywhere) · Ctrl+, open settings (everywhere) · Ctrl+Alt+Space quick capture (system-wide) · Ctrl+D today's daily note (everywhere) · Alt+M ask for suggestions (the focused object) · Alt+→ Alt+← doc ⇄ inspector (editor) · [ ] Route/Tidy lens (inbox) · Alt+1/2/3 compact·context·metadata (search palette) · Shift+Tab Mission Control (everywhere) · Ctrl+Shift+T reopen closed tab (this workspace) · M more properties fold (inspector) · H row menu (inspector rows) · 🔒 ⏎ Esc accept·dismiss [convention — not rebindable] (every AI card); footnote "click any key to rebind — record mode: 'press a key…'. a conflict warns inline, never a modal; pressing the taken key again steals it, with an undo toast. search, inspector and suggestion cards re-key together." AI (app; "the one switch, who pays for the model, and how loud the suggestions are. nothing here changes WHAT the AI may do — that contract is fixed."): "Automation" row + amber chip "✦ the consent boundary" + toggle; copy "off kills the assist layer whole — no halos, no suggestion cards, no Copilot lens, no Ask. everything deterministic keeps working untouched: capture, filters, views, search are hard logic, not AI. the assist layer is removable, not load-bearing."; "Plan" section ("billing only — the contract is identical on both") radio cards: "Liv subscription [default]" — "calls go through Liv's server-side proxy — the key never ships in the binary, per-user caps." + meter "this month ▓62%▓ 62% of cap"; "Bring your own key" — "your Anthropic API key, stored in the OS keychain — never in the vault, never synced, never on our servers." + masked "sk-ant-••••••••••••••••" + reveal eye ("Reveal — asks the keychain") + [keychain] tag; "Suggestion aggressiveness" seg [Quiet | Standard (on) | Eager] — "how often cards appear uninvited. quiet: only when you ask (Alt+M). standard: also on inbox items. eager: also on save when core fields sit empty. frequency — never permission."; amber rulebox "the fixed contract (not settings): the AI is a suggester and navigator, never a silent editor — every action is a visible card with accept ⏎ / dismiss. values come only from your vault + the seeded vocabulary, never invented. every ✦ mark points into one queue — Inbox › Tidy. and the AI never touches tier — importance is human judgment." FOOT BAR (below panes): "Ctrl+, open settings · ↑↓ sections · type filters everything · ⏎ jump to the exact row · changes apply instantly — there is no Save button". ONBOARDING: title bar keeps a permanent dashed pill "✦ take the tour" (mockup HTML:140; foot contract "replay: the ✦ pill in the title bar"). The tour (sim `ov-onboarding`) is ONE overlay panel (620px card): header = "L" mark + "Welcome to Liv" + "five small steps · under a minute · replayed on your live vault — nothing here writes" + pill "Skip the tour — open Liv [Esc]" (title: "skipping still opens Liv — the tour never auto-shows again"); clickable labeled dot-nav STEPS = Folder · Topics · Capture · The aha · Consent with done/current states; each step opens with a coach block "TOUR · STEP n OF 5" + a "skip the tour" link; footer contract "every step is skippable — skipping still opens Liv · the tour never auto-shows again · replay: the ✦ pill in the title bar". Step 1 Folder: "One folder holds everything. Notes, boards, even your saved views — real files, yours with or without Liv." · label "your vault" · path row (default ~/Desktop/Liv) + "Change…" (native folder picker) · hint "a cloud-synced local folder (Google Drive, iCloud) works too" · link "point Liv at a folder I already have →" (existing-folder mode: "Liv indexes in place, adds only library/ + .liv/ as siblings; nothing is moved or rewritten") · trust beat "Your files are real files on your disk — notes are .md, boards and views are files too. If Liv disappeared tomorrow, you keep everything, structure included." · "nothing is written until you press Start." + [Start] · "Esc skips, innermost first". Step 2 Topics: "What does your life hold? A few picks seed the shelves — the areas, subjects and statuses that fit. Skip it and Liv still works." · label "seeds your vocabulary — zero AI · optional · skippable" · chips = the vault's own top-6 subjects with counts + tooltip "N objects in your vault · latest: <title>" (empty state "no subjects in the vault yet — the vocabulary grows as you use it") · hints "seeds → subjects: <picks> + areas: <workspace scopes> · rename anything later — Settings › Vocabulary" and "replayed on your live vault — these chips are your own subjects, counted from the database" · "picks write vocabulary only — nothing is filed for you" · actions ← Back / "skip this step" / Continue. Step 3 Capture: "Empty your head. Type a thought, Ctrl+Enter, next one. No names, no folders, no dialogs — filing comes later, on your terms." · three STATIC example prompts (contractual strings): "steven owes me 300" / "ring länsförsäkringar innan 1 aug — 164 kr/mån offerten" / "tab-video: open on the 497-tabs screenshot, not the app"; first two shown as ✓ used pills; capture card with the 3rd + caret + "will save to → library/inbox" + [Send · Ctrl+⏎] ("the tour advances on the action, not a timer") · state hints: assist on → "✦ the first two were sent — assist named them, visibly and editably, and they wait in Inbox"; off → "assist is off — the first two were sent and keep their raw first line as title" · "2 captured · 1 in the box — and your inbox already holds N scraps that arrived exactly this way". Step 4 The aha: "Your captures landed in Inbox — nothing was filed behind your back. When you ask, assist proposes; the proposal is a visible diff and you decide, always." · card "Inbox · N unsorted · vault-wide · your real scraps — click one to land on it" + REAL scrap rows from the vault · amber suggestion card: "✦ assist" + head + text + visible −/+ diff ("the visible diff — exactly what Accept would write, nothing else") + "values from your vault + the seeded shelves — never invented" + [Looks right — continue] / [open Inbox › Tidy] (leaves the tour, opens the one queue) + "id: <idline> · dismissed ids are remembered, never re-asked" · degrade states: automation off → "the automation switch is off — assist is dormant, nothing points here. The last step holds the switch."; queue clear → "the queue is clear — nothing waits in Tidy right now." · foot "nothing is written from the tour". Step 5 Consent: "Last thing — where assist stops. Below is the real switch from Settings › AI, surfaced once. Unplug it and Liv still works — the core is deterministic." / "flip it any time — Settings › AI" · Gate 1 "Automation — Settings › AI · the named consent boundary" with live sub (on: "on — assist may point (quiet ✦ marks) and propose. It writes only when you accept; every proposal waits in one queue: Inbox › Tidy · N waiting now"; off: "off — fully manual. Nothing suggests, every ✦ in the app is dark. Capture, filing and find keep working.") + THE REAL SWITCH ("the same control as Settings › AI; flipping it here flips it everywhere") · Gate 2 "Your key — Settings › AI · bring your own": "calls go from this machine to your provider — never through a Liv server. No key: naming and proposals pause; capture, filing and find keep working." + masked key + "stored in your OS keychain" · "nothing new was invented for this screen — these are the two gates from Settings › AI. [open Settings →]" · primary [That's Liv — you're in]. BP-2 stays valid where unoverridden: first-run creates the vault on Start (library/ skeleton + seeded vocabulary), skip = straight to the after-state with seeds intact + default vault, resume-at-dot after kill, coach advances on completed action never timers, seeded banner "we filled the shelves" hideable, disabled buttons explain themselves on hover.

areas.spec_summary: The sim (app-sim.js, 4051 lines) is a full working model whose behaviors are the contract. KEYBOARD MAP (one document-level keydown, lines 705-715): Esc = close active overlay, else close all popovers (overlays: search|ask|graph|mission|onboarding); Ctrl/Cmd+K OR Ctrl/Cmd+O = open the search palette and focus the query; Ctrl/Cmd+Z when NOT in a text field = the one undo; Shift+Tab (not typing, no Ctrl) = toggle Mission Control; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M = same toggle; on the Inbox surface, bare "[" = Route lens, "]" = Tidy lens (absolute, not cycle); Enter inside the capture box = capture.add. Contractual kbd copy elsewhere: rail chevron tooltips "Back (Alt+←)"/"Forward (Alt+→)"; Capture header "Ctrl+Alt+Space — from anywhere"; blank-tab landing "Create new note Ctrl N · Go to file Ctrl O · Choose tab type — all departments" + "a blank tab becomes an Editor once content materialises"; editor toolbar "bold · Ctrl+B", "italic · Ctrl+I"; editor footer "Ctrl+Z undo" + word count + "Vault/<folder>/<title>.md"; onboarding step 3 "Ctrl+⏎ send · the box refocuses"; inspector digit hints per property row (1=amount 2=type 3=subjects 4=people 5=project 6=area 7=tier 8=when/due/date/valid-until 9=status, "m" More properties). UNDO (lines 283-291): snapshot before every mutate (DB entities+suggestions, selection, suggestion-done map, open notes, active note; stack cap 25); every mutating toast appends "· Ctrl+Z undoes it"; undo toast "Undone — one step back, exactly as saved"; empty stack "Nothing to undo". Undoable ops: task.toggle, capture.add, scrap.commit, sugg.accept, sugg.dismiss, notes.new, notes.check (checkbox pill rewrites the "- [ ]" line in body text; toast "Toggled in the text — the note itself is the source"), comms.open unread-clear, se.save (search saved as a real view entity), bases.new. Not undoable: ws/tab/layer/pin/bookmark/split/UI state. WORKSPACE SWITCH (ws.switch, 442-447): always lands on the desk (Notes altitude), per-workspace typed tab set + per-ws active index restored, mint a blank tab if the set is empty, toast "Workspace: X — its own tabs restored, landed on the desk · scope area Y / project Z". Home is builtIn: rename/archive refuse ("Home is protected"). SCOPING (234-255): desk surfaces filter by workspace areaTag (+projectTag); ambient tools (tasks, library, calendar, comms, inbox, contacts) are vault-wide; ws.everywhere toggles the lens off ("Scope: everywhere — the workspace lens is off"); projectPin (rail popover + Vault panel) narrows EVERY list, incl. vault-wide tools, click-again clears ("Pinned to X — every scoped list narrows"). Ambient mode hides the tab strip + slots bar, hub reads "Liv", banner "vault-wide tool — the workspace lens does not apply here". IOU ACCEPT (sugg g-iou, 502-509 + contacts 1956-1996): Accept deletes scrap "Steven owes me 300", creates {type:iou, title "Steven — IOU", people:[Steven], amount:300, subjects:[money], assist:true}, toast "Accepted — IOU created and linked. Steven's page now shows the computed net."; Steven's contact page recomputes iouNet every render — seeded −60 swish so accepting yields "owes you 240 kr · 2 open IOUs", chips per IOU entity (✦ on assist-made), dashed "computed" badge, tooltip "computed from the open IOU entries — hard logic, no AI involved · settle the entries, never the computed line". CAPTURE→BADGE (495-499): capture.add prepends {type:scrap, title, created:'now', area: ws.scope||null}, clears+refocuses the box, toast "Captured — no questions asked. It waits in Inbox · Route · stamped X (visible chip, one Ctrl+Z)"; badges.grey = scrap count ticks instantly on the rail Inbox icon, left-panel Global row, Inbox header pill, Route seg count. ROUTE: commit buttons "Commit as note"(primary)/"Commit as task"/"Later" — commit stamps type, leaves the set, next scrap auto-selected ("Committed as X — one small write, it left the inbox, next scrap selected"); Later cycles ("Later — skipped, no debt"). TIDY: amber halo cards grouped by group name, −/+ diff rows, target chip, Accept/Dismiss, mono id footer ("id: assist/iou/steven-owes-me-300#type+people+amount"), "dismissed is remembered forever — by deterministic id, never asked again"; automation off → "the automation switch is off — assist is dormant". MISSION CONTROL (3193-3295): Shift+Tab overlay on 22px blur over the live app, × top-right, Esc closes; views row Today/Guidance/Review pills + ‹ › cycle + "＋" (toast "max 10 views"); widget board (same engine also hosted by the Dashboard department tab): catalog of 8 (welcome/quick/agenda/sugg/resume/kinds on; today/graph off), "＋ Add widget" toggles an inline gallery with ✓ added/＋ add chips, hover controls ◂ ▸ move and × remove; every widget computed live from the DB, workspace-scoped except Resume ("vault-wide — resume ignores the workspace lens on purpose"); Suggestions widget has inline Accept →/× dismiss; Kinds "computed on read — a count is never a stored fact". PALETTE (3310-3527): zero-state shows scope tiles "This workspace · Name (n)"/"Everywhere (n)" + "a workspace scopes; it never contains" + Recent 5; three display modes Compact/Context/Metadata "remembered across both states" (Context = <mark> body snippet, Metadata = chips); results grouped by kind in fixed order with counts, "never silently capped"; footer "Save as view" (writes a real view entity: query+lens+display, undoable), "Export N" (markdown, nothing changes), "Open in view →" (closes palette, opens Library); grammar hint chips tier:1, status:done, -subjects:gym, has:due; live per keystroke, only the results region re-renders; grammar = free text + property:value over type/status/tier/area/subject(s)/people/project/has/no with "-" negation. Left-panel Props click → seeds "has:key"; graph value-node click → seeds "subject:x" ("Exited into the vault filtered to subject:x — one grammar everywhere"). TAB SYSTEM: typed department tabs {dept, sub, entity} (editor.note/canvas/table/kanban, files.view/folder/list, capture, dashboard, tasks, library, comms, blank); "＋" mints a blank ("never instantly a note"); ⌄ picker "New tab — departments only (object kinds live inside)"; picking ask → overlay ("The answerer is stateless — no tab needed"); import → Library ("Import is a tool inside Library — one batch, one transaction, one undo"); openTab dedups on same entity+dept; closing the last tab mints a blank. SPLITS (notes surface 1083-1131): content-tab strip of open notes inside the Editor tab; split button (disabled until a 2nd note is open, tooltip "up to 4 panes — one inspector follows focus · open a second note first"); split shows 2 panes, focused pane gets accent ring, click moves ring+caret+inspector (notes.focus), star + inspector follow the focused note, view row "panes N of 4". LAYERS (471-476): restore MERGES the saved tab group into the current workspace with dedup — "restore merges into this workspace — nothing is written", toast "Layer 'X' restored — N tabs merged · a Layer lists pointers, nothing was written". HISTORY (299-311): places ring {mode, ws, tabIdx}, 40-cap, rail chevrons dim at ends. OTHER: toast bus (2.8s); theme.cycle rail button brand-light→brand-dark→night→google; automation toggle darkens every ✦ (body.no-assist), amber badge→0, capture halos die, Tidy/Ask dormant, toasts "Assist is awake — proposals return to the one queue"/"Automation off — the consent boundary. Every ✦ in the app just went dark."; canvas camera (drag-pan on bg, Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zoom-to-cursor 10-400%, wheel pans, zoom % readout, fit resets; link nodes toast, never navigate); openEntity type→home routing (note/project/canvas→editor tab; task→tasks, person+iou→contacts, event→calendar, file/link/view/list→library, message→comms, scrap→inbox); onboarding 5-step tour (Folder/Topics/Capture/The aha/Consent) replayed on the live vault, step 5 hosts the REAL automation switch + BYOK row, "the tour never auto-shows again · replay: the ✦ pill in the title bar".

Per the headline override this palette is the combined Search-or-Ask surface — the sim still ships Ask as a separate overlay, so only the binding is settled here (see open question).

deltas.title: Palette feature set: scope tiles, 3 display modes, kind groups, footer verbs
deltas.detail: Zero-state: 'Search in' tiles [This workspace · <name> (n-in-ws)] / [Everywhere (n-vault)] toggling the everywhere lens, note 'a workspace scopes; it never contains', Recent 5 rows. Mode seg Compact/Context/Metadata persisted across states (Context = first-match <mark> body snippet with field label; Metadata = up to 3 chips + '+n' + status dot). Results grouped by kind in fixed order note,project,task,event,person,message,file,link,scrap,iou,view with per-group counts; count line 'N results · the whole vault — never silently capped'; hint chips tier:1 status:done -subjects:gym has:due appended to the query on click; footer 'Save as view' (writes a real view entity: query+lens+display config, undoable, lands in Library), 'Export N' (markdown; vault untouched), 'Open in view →' (closes palette, opens the result set as a center view). Grammar needs has:/no: predicates and '-' negation on both words and pairs.

deltas.title: Everywhere scope toggle
deltas.detail: ws.everywhere flips the workspace lens off globally; toasts 'Scope: everywhere — the workspace lens is off' / 'Scope: this workspace'; palette scope tiles read and write it; scoped lists and calendar honour it (view rows show scope 'everywhere').

deltas.title: Project-pin filter (distinct from Favourites pin)
deltas.detail: A rail folder button with dot-when-active opens a 'Pin project' popover (Show all + every project); Vault panel project rows also pin. While set, EVERY list — including vault-wide tools — narrows to entities whose project matches (or the project itself); click-again clears. Toasts 'Pinned to X — every scoped list narrows' / 'Pin cleared — showing all'. Shell-side filter state, never written.

deltas.title: Workspace switch lands on the desk with a scope toast
deltas.detail: ws.switch always sets the Notes altitude (as-built keeps the current surface), restores the per-ws tab set (exists: Window.swift:1961-1969), mints a blank tab when the set is empty, clamps the active index, toast 'Workspace: X — its own tabs restored, landed on the desk · scope area Y/project Z'. Home builtIn refuses rename/archive with 'Home is protected — …' toasts; archive copy 'Hidden from here, restorable in Settings → Archived workspaces'.

deltas.title: Inbox [ ] = absolute lens select; keep the triage keys
deltas.detail: Sim: '[' selects Route, ']' selects Tidy directly (app-sim.js:713) — as-built cycles both ways (Window.swift:3196-3199). Keep j/k, a/r, A/R, ⏎ (as-built-only, not contradicted). Seg labels 'Route · n [' and 'Tidy · n ]' with kbd chips; header sub 'one cleanup home — halos elsewhere point, this lists'.

deltas.title: Route commit flow: two commit buttons + Later with auto-advance
deltas.detail: Selected-scrap pane with 'Commit as note' (primary)/'Commit as task'/'Later'; commit stamps the type (exists: model.setType, Window.swift:781+), auto-selects the next scrap, line 'Commit stamps a type — it leaves, next selected', toast 'Committed as X — one small write, it left the inbox, next scrap selected'; Later cycles selection with 'Later — skipped, no debt'; empty state 'the inbox is empty — nothing needs routing today'.

deltas.title: IOU kind + computed person netting + the IOU accept path
deltas.detail: New object kind 'iou' (people[], amount kr, subjects, assist flag). Person page grows a computed money line — net = Σ amounts of open IOUs naming the person, rendered 'owes you N kr / you owe N kr / settled · N open IOUs' with a dashed 'computed' badge, per-IOU chips (✦ when assist-made) that open the IOU entity, tooltip 'computed from the open IOU entries — hard logic, no AI involved'; inspector person lens shows 'Money — computed, never stored'. The clerk gains an IOU proposal whose Accept (one transaction) retires the source scrap and creates the linked IOU so the person page recomputes live — the sim's canonical demo: accepting 'Steven owes me 300' over a seeded −60 swish yields 'owes you 240 kr · 2 open IOUs'. Netting itself is shell-computed on read; the proposal rule + kind vocabulary need services/clerk work.

deltas.title: Capture stamps the workspace area, visibly, one undo
deltas.detail: capture.add stamps area = the active workspace's scope on the new scrap; the destination line reads '→ lands typeless in Inbox · Route · stamped <area> — visible chip, one Ctrl+Z'; toast 'Captured — no questions asked. It waits in Inbox · Route · stamped <area> (visible chip, one Ctrl+Z)'; the box clears and refocuses; Enter submits. lotus_capture_at takes text only today, so stamping area in the same transaction likely needs an additive FFI variant (or capture+set as one undo group).

deltas.title: Department-typed tabs (capture/dashboard/tasks/library/comms as tabs)
deltas.detail: Sim tabs are {dept, sub?, entity?} over a department catalog (Editor: note/canvas/table/kanban · Files: view/folder/list · Capture · Dashboard · Tasks · Library · Comms); the ⌄ picker offers departments only ('New tab — departments only (object kinds live inside)'); picking Ask opens the overlay instead ('The answerer is stateless — no tab needed'); picking Import routes to Library ('Import is a tool inside Library — one batch, one transaction, one undo'). As-built TabKind is desk/blank/note/file only (Tabs.swift:19-29) and those tools are rail surfaces. Extend TabKind + the picker; keep dedup-on-open, in-place blank convert, close-ring.

deltas.title: Editor split panes (2 shipped, '4' in copy) with one following inspector
deltas.detail: Inside the Editor tab: a content-tab strip of open notes; a split button — disabled with tooltip 'up to 4 panes — one inspector follows focus · open a second note first' until a second note is open, then splits; the focused pane wears an accent ring; clicking a pane moves ring + caret + the ONE inspector; the bookmark star follows the focused note; 'close split'; inspector view row 'panes N of 4'. As-built has no splits and hard-guards one editor (Window.swift:2662-2675).

deltas.title: Layer restore merges instead of replacing
deltas.detail: Sim: restore MERGES the saved tab group into the current workspace, deduping identical tabs, active lands on the first restored — 'restore merges into this workspace — nothing is written', toast 'Layer "X" restored — N tabs merged … a Layer lists pointers, nothing was written'. As-built replaces the whole set with a stash-undo toast (Window.swift:1747-1800). Adopt merge semantics; the stash-undo toast can stay as belt-and-braces.

deltas.title: Stateless Ask overlay with AUTO read log, cited stream, one proposal
deltas.detail: Rail Ask opens an overlay (never a tab): header '✦ Ask · stateless — each question starts from zero · close it and it's gone'; hint 'asks your vault, not the web · no sessions, no model picker, no transcript'; automation off → dormant panel ('Search still answers exact questions'); on: an AUTO read-log card (search_vault('…') n hits + read_<type>('title') rows, each tagged AUTO; footer 'reads run silently and are always logged · no write ever hides in an AUTO row'), a streamed answer whose inline [n] refs open the live entities, a cites list ('cited — click opens the object'), and exactly ONE proposal card that stages into the real Tidy queue ('→ waits in Inbox · Tidy', id footer 'dismissed ids are never re-asked'); Accept from the overlay only routes — 'routed to the one queue — nothing written here'. Supersedes the persistent Chats surface (Surface.aiChat).

deltas.title: Automation-off global dimming
deltas.detail: Flipping the switch toasts 'Assist is awake — proposals return to the one queue' / 'Automation off — the consent boundary. Every ✦ in the app just went dark.' and dims app-wide: amber badge → 0 (badges() gates on automation), capture-card halos drop, Tidy lens + Ask + Copilot lens show dormant copy, Mission Control Suggestions widget reads 'the automation switch is off — assist is dormant, nothing is proposed'. As-built has the real switch (Settings.swift:1506+); verify every ✦ site subscribes.

deltas.title: Blank-tab landing gains the third row
deltas.detail: Sim landing: 'Create new note (Ctrl N)', 'Go to file (Ctrl O)', 'Choose tab type — all departments' (opens the dept picker) + footnote 'a blank tab becomes an Editor once content materialises'. As-built BlankTabLanding has the first two only (Tabs.swift:644-683).

deltas.title: Left-panel Props/Graph exits into the one search grammar
deltas.detail: Props tab: click a key row → palette opens seeded 'has:<key>'. Vault-graph overlay: click a value node → palette seeded 'subject:<s>' with toast 'Exited into the vault filtered to subject:<s> — one grammar everywhere'; kind checkboxes toggle map membership with toasts 'Hidden from the map — the data itself is untouched'/'Back on the map'; object-node click opens the entity; deterministic ring layout, forces sliders decorative ('the layout is deterministic … forces wake when a vault outgrows one screen'). As-built VaultGraph.swift exists (⌃⇧G) — align exit-to-search + toggle behaviors.

deltas.title: Checkbox pills rewrite the note body
deltas.detail: '- [ ]' lines in a note render as pills under the editor ('Checkboxes in this note'); clicking rewrites exactly that line's [ ]/[x] in the body text, stamps modified, toast 'Toggled in the text — the note itself is the source', one undo.

deltas.title: Comms: opening an unread clears the flag as one undoable write
deltas.detail: comms.open on an unread message mutates unread=false (snapshotted, undoable) then routes to the entity; fetch is idempotent — 'fetched — 0 new · external-id makes re-import a no-op'. Rides the BP-15 Comms surface build.

deltas.title: Theme cycle affordance on the rail
deltas.detail: A rail moon button cycles brand-light → brand-dark → night → google with toast 'Theme: <id>'. Themes.swift already ships the four token sets (P20a) — only the cycle control + toast are missing.

deltas.title: Mission Control quick-actions widget kbd + capture routing
deltas.detail: Quick actions: 'Search everything — notes, tabs, commands… (Ctrl O kbd)' opens the palette; 'Quick capture — jot something down fast' opens a Capture department tab (tab.pick), not just focusing a field.

deltas.title: openEntity home-surface routing incl. iou→person
deltas.detail: Type routing contract: note/project/canvas → an Editor tab (dedup); task→Tasks, person→Contacts, event→Calendar, file/link/view/list→Library, message→Comms, scrap→Inbox, iou→Contacts with the IOU's first person selected. Verify as-built open paths match once new kinds land.

deltas.title: Retire ⌘⇧M-as-surface-nav in favor of the toggle pair
deltas.detail: ⌘⇧M currently navigates to the Dashboard surface (Window.swift:2539-2544). Under the new spec ⌘⇧M and Shift+Tab both TOGGLE the Mission Control overlay; the Dashboard department tab remains the docked host of the same board.

open_questions: Search-or-Ask merge: the headline override says Ctrl+K is ONE combined palette, but the sim ships two overlays (ov-search on Ctrl+K/O, ov-ask on the rail/tab-picker) with no mode switch between them — which wins: one palette with an Ask mode, or Ctrl+K→search + a separate Ask overlay as the sim actually behaves?

Suggestion dismiss undoability: the sim routes sugg.dismiss through the undo snapshot (Ctrl+Z revives a dismissed proposal) while its own copy and the as-built law say 'dismissed is remembered forever — by deterministic id' with declines off the undo stack (Window.swift:3200-3205). Is dismiss undoable or permanent?

History chord: sim rail tooltips advertise Alt+←/→ for back/forward, but the as-built deliberately gave Alt+←/→ to inspector panel/doc focus (bp1 badge 32) and uses ⌘[/⌘] — does the new spec reclaim Alt+←/→ for history, and where does inspector focus move?
Capture submit key: the capture surface submits on plain Enter (sim keydown 714) while onboarding step 3 teaches Ctrl+⏎ ('the box refocuses') — one key or both?
Undo depth: the sim caps its snapshot stack at 25; the core's log undo has no such cap — is 25 a contract or a sim artifact?
Layer restore: adopt the sim's merge-with-dedup ('nothing was written') and DROP the as-built stash-undo toast, or keep both (merge + undo of the merge)?
Splits: the copy promises 'up to 4 panes' everywhere but the sim implements exactly 2 — is 2 acceptable for the port milestone with the 4-pane copy kept?

Workspace-scoped area stamping at capture (one transaction incl. area) needs an additive FFI variant of lotus_capture_at or a sanctioned two-write pattern — owner call required per the FFI boundary rules.
